description: Get the facts about an Australian marine park from its Biohotspot page: area, IUCN categories and named zones (CAPAD 2024), habitats, blue carbon and pressures measured inside it, each with its source and licence, and the page's address. Give part of the park's name; `state` (wa, qld, nsw, vic, sa, tas, nt, com for Commonwealth waters) narrows it. Several matches return the list to choose from; parks under 10 km² or without enough open data have no page. Read-only.

name.description: Park name or part of it, e.g. 'Ningaloo'

name: get_marine_park
title: Australian marine park facts
